We believe agents will transform the economy. That future will be shaped by domain-specific agents differentiated by their knowledge, data, and UX. These agents will be sold as standalone products and also used to transform internal company operations. The companies that control these systems will build lasting competitive advantages. To capture that opportunity, every company will need to own its intelligence. Companies should be free to choose the best models for their needs, control their data and infrastructure, and continuously improve their agents, while maintaining the governance needed to operate securely at scale. That’s why we’ve built LangSmith, the framework-agnostic platform to run, improve, and govern agents . More than 7,000 organizations already rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups like Harvey, Rippling, and Listen Labs to Fortune 500 enterprises like NVIDIA, Toyota, and Salesforce. Clay uses LangSmith to monitor hundreds of millions of agent runs per month and improve their agents. Workday uses LangSmith to run and govern agents across the organization, reducing the time to deploy a new agent from five months to under a day. LangSmith provides the foundation for companies to control their agent systems across three pillars – Agent Runtime, Agent Improvement, and Agent Governance: Agent Runtime gives teams the architecture and infrastructure to run agents reliably. Deep Agents, LangGraph, and LangChain give developers flexibility across models and control over how context is managed. LangSmith Agent Server and Sandboxes allow teams to deploy and run agents securely at scale, whether in the cloud or in their environment. LangSmith Managed Agents and Fleet provide fully managed services to build, deploy, and run mission-critical agents in production. Agent Improvement helps teams test, monitor, and improve agent performance. LangSmith Observability and Evaluation give teams visibility into how agents behave and measure quality. LangSmith Engine, our in-platform agent, automates improvement by finding errors, writing code and prompt fixes, and monitoring production traffic for regressions. LangSmith Fine-Tuning helps teams turn agent traces into training data to fine-tune and evaluate specialized models. Agent Governance gives teams centralized control over how agents use models, tools, and data. Our LLM and Tool Gateways help teams manage model budgets and fallbacks, protect sensitive data, and govern tool access and authentication across teams and agents . text: Follow us on 4 Today we’re delighted to announce two milestones: the general availability of LlamaParse, and our $19M series A funding round. LlamaParse is the core of our enterprise offering: a turn-key solution for agentic knowledge management over your unstructured data. It’s the most secure, accurate, and easy to use platform to enable building knowledge agents. Use one of our hundreds of available integrations to connect to your enterprise data, and let us take care of parsing, ingesting, indexing, and retrieval for you, as well as uptime and reliability. LlamaParse is available both as an instant-setup SaaS offering and an on-premise solution for higher security and data locality guarantees. It’s also highly private and secure, with SOC 2 Type 2 certification. Now in general availability, you can sign up today and join happy customers like Rakuten, Carlyle, Salesforce and KPMG. If you’re in the EU, you may be interested in our GDPR-compliant EU SaaS offering , featuring guaranteed EU data residency. Ready to get started with LlamaParse? Explore our free and paid plans today. Learn more LlamaParse is powered by LlamaParse, our industry-leading solution for parsing complex, unstructured document formats like PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoints, and hundreds of other formats. LlamaParse takes care of complex elements like tables, charts and images with ease, and has handled hundreds of millions of documents for tens of thousands of satisfied users already. Learn more about LlamaParse . You can build on top of LlamaParse and LlamaParse using the LlamaIndex framework, our leading open-source framework in Python and TypeScript . Our event-driven Workflows architecture makes it easy to put together scalable, predictable AI agents, and developers love it! Our series A is led by Norwest Venture Partners, with participation from our existing investors Greylock Partners, bringing our total capital raised to $27.5M. Dave Zilberman, general partner at Norwest Venture Partners, says “LlamaIndex is compelling for Norwest as we’ve been closely studying enterprise requirements for AI adoption, specifically around data preparation, ingestion and custom agents as part of an ongoing investment thesis. We’re hiring in all sorts of positions to expand our OSS frameworks, further improve LlamaParse, go even deeper on LlamaParse, and accelerate our go-to-market. Check out our open positions !

title: Browserbase Raises $40M Series B | Browserbase | Browserbase
text: June 18, 2025 Building the future of web automation Paul Klein Company 3 min read Try our new product, Director.ai today In this hyper-fast world of AI, in order to compete you have to keep up. Even since starting Browserbase 16 months ago, I’ve seen the promises of AI turn into production-ready reality. We’re proud to be part of this transformation, building the infrastructure that makes web automation accessible to everyone. What started with a thesis that AI agents would require great browser infrastructure, has turned into billion dollar companies using Browserbase to deliver better outcomes for their customers. Building on a foundation of primitives The most transformative technology companies (Twilio, Stripe, Vercel) all share something in common: they’re primitives. They provide the fundamental building blocks that enable developers to create powerful applications. Browser infrastructure represents the next critical primitive. It’s the foundation that will change how people interact with and automate the web, empowering developers to build software that fundamentally transforms online work. The opportunity ahead Think about how often we interact with a web browser: buying products, sending messages, deploying code. Now consider all the routine online tasks, from sending emails to booking travel, that consume our time every single day. The future of browsing is selective automation. Humans will still do the joyful, discovery-driven tasks. But repetitive, time-consuming work should be done by software. That’s what we’re building for. This vision where AI handles the boring parts while humans focus on what matters, represents a massive business opportunity. If Browserbase can become the rails of this new era, we’ll be enabling an entirely new category of applications. And yes, maybe developers are inherently lazy, we build tools to avoid repetitive work. Browserbase is the ultimate expression of that philosophy. Expanding our platform Along with our Series B announcement and lots of small product improvements, we’re announcing three main platform upgrades: Director.ai : Browserbase has always been built for developers, and we plan to always help developers automate the web, but in this era of AI, everyone can be a developer. And that’s why we’re launching Director. Director is here to let anyone automate the web, generate Stagehand scripts and deploy them on Browserbase. It’s empowering. And it’s transformational for infrastructure companies like us, which traditionally only sold to developers, but now we can sell or support everybody. I think that’s monumental. Stagehand for Python : We’re now working with two of the most popular programming languages, Python and Node.js. And I’m very excited for that. The Python version also comes with enhanced observability features built into the Browserbase dashboard, including session recordings, token usage tracking, and comprehensive logging. We’re lowering our prices : We’ve been hard at work improving our infrastructure to continue to offer better pricing and value. We hope to make automation a more accessible tool for all builders. Here are the key changes, but you can see all the details here. Hobby Developer plan : 50% price reduction to get started, from $39 to $20/month for 100 browser hours and 1 GB of proxies. More concurrent browsers : From 3 to 25 on the Developer plan & doubled concurrency from 25 to 50 browsers on the Startup plan. New feature : Variable-size browsers for scale customers, choose from our pre-configured small, medium, or large instances. Series B & beyond The product release coincides with a $40 million Series B financing round led by Notable Capital, with participation from existing investors CRV and Kleiner Perkins. This new funding marks our commitment to the long haul. Our team, investors, and most importantly, our customers share a vision of a future where people operate with unprecedented leverage through intelligent automation. The journey ahead is substantial. Browser infrastructure still needs deep innovation—in the browser technology itself, the surrounding infrastructure, and all the supplemental features required to build powerful applications on this foundation. The market opportunity attracts competition, which we welcome. In markets this large, innovation benefits everyone, pushing the entire ecosystem forward and delivering better solutions for customers. Looking ahead to the next year at Browserbase, our mission remains clear: help everyone automate the web. We’re building the best browser infrastructure platform, the most powerful framework, and the most accessible application to make that vision reality. We can’t wait to see what everyone builds. text: ABOUT US At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE Designs, builds and improves what the GTM Agent does to create pipeline, from the first signal about a prospect to a booked meeting. Owns the software and agents behind outbound on every channel: inbound lead follow-up, prospecting, multi-channel sequences, email deliverability, calling and the quality of every message the agent writes, with people deciding what goes out. Serves Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), Account Executives (AEs), their managers and Marketing. The goal of the role is business impact for those teams: more positive replies, more meetings booked and more qualified pipeline for every dollar spent. Additionally, this role has a communication and evangelizing component: showing the teams it serves what works, and sharing content and open source projects with our developer community. This role suits an engineer who has already built agents or software for outbound and prospecting, such as sequencing, email deliverability, dialing or AI-written outreach. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Spends time with SDRs, AEs and their managers to find the prospecting work they repeat that the agent can take over. - Designs, builds and improves the agent's outbound workflows: what starts each run, what the agent reads and decides, what it drafts, and what waits for a rep's approval. - Builds the agentic system that follows up every inbound lead within minutes: it qualifies the lead, researches the person and the account, and drafts a first touch for the owner the routing rules assign. - Builds and improves the system that runs Marketing's outbound plays and campaigns for every rep, from the target list to the first touch. - Builds the software and agentic system behind multi-channel sequences, which combine email, LinkedIn and calls, choose each next touch from what the prospect did, and stop when the prospect replies on any channel. - Builds the email sending and deliverability system: sending domains and mailboxes, warm-up, daily limits, address checks, bounces, opt-outs and inbox placement across mail providers. - Builds the calling software reps use: call lists, dialing and the research a rep reads before each call. - Owns the quality of what the agent writes, so every message fits the prospect's signal, their history with us and the right product, and uses how much reps edit each message and the replies it gets to find what to fix. - Builds the safeguards that keep prospects from getting duplicate or overlapping outreach, and the sync that logs every email, LinkedIn action and call in Salesforce. - Builds experiments that test messages, channels, timing and sequences against held-out groups, measures which ones book meetings, and fixes or removes what doesn't. - Writes evals for every feature shipped, and ships each feature with its scorecard row. - Shows reps and their managers what works, and shares it through blog posts, webinars and open source. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - AI-Native Developer: You have a deep understanding of the LLM stack: prompting, retrieval (RAG), cognitive architectures, and agentic loops. You have likely already built with LangChain or LangGraph. - Engineering Foundation: You are a strong software engineer (typically 3+ years) with at least 1 year of experience specifically shipping LLM systems in production. - Self-Directed "Founder" Mentality: You don't need a ticket to tell you what to fix. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying high-impact problems, and driving them to completion autonomously. - Full-Stack Capability: Strong coding skills in Python or TypeScript (ideally both) and the ability to build end-to-end applications. - Customer-Centric: You enjoy the intersection of high-level engineering and direct customer impact. You can translate a customer's technical pain point into a scalable system architecture. NICE TO HAVES - Expertise with LangSmith for evaluation and monitoring. - Experience building or maintaining open-source projects. - A background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or high-growth GTM teams. COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.
